id./param/scenario/cs/c_020_cs_090.pack|cs_:
"Only the Sword of Light's power could
  completely destroy the evil god's body.

"But with Erdwin gone, none can
  wield the Sword of Light.

"If we cannot destroy him,
  we can only seal him.
  Sage Serenica, I'm counting on you.

"...I will now confine the sealed body of the
  evil god in the sky, far above the earth.
  Please lend me your strength.

"Flown that high, it looks like a star.
  Surely no one will realize what it is.

"I'll return the Sword of Light to
  its rightful place... Yggdrasil.

"After that... I'll set out on a journey.
  To meet him once more...

"This is Time's Sphere...
  If I break it...

Serenica raised her sword
and struck it against
Time's Sphere!

But the sword shattered
into pieces...
"I wanted... to see you... once more...

"What we thought was Erdwin's Lantern was
  actually what sealed the evil god...

"You two have done well fulfilling
  your mission to guide the Luminary.

"We saw it too. To think Lady Serenica
  had taken such a form...

"...Yes. Sage Serenica, who holds the key
  to defeating the evil god, changed her form
  and still lives in that tower.

"...Seer. I've been wondering.
  How do you know about such
  ancient times?
"Hmm. Then let me show my true form.

"Yes... I am Morcant.
  Companion of the legendary Luminary, Erdwin.
